finding.description: The pinned generation's meta slot no longer verifies: a later open would select the other slot.
A page the generation's commit manifest lists, or a manifest-overflow page, no longer carries its recorded identity.
A catalog page fails verification or does not decode.
The stored catalog chain is not the encoding of the snapshot's catalog.
A sequence's current value lies outside its minimum and maximum.
A pointer names a page outside the body range [first body page, page_count). key is set when an overflow pointer of a row names it.
A pointer names a page the walk already reached: two trees, two nodes, or two overflow values share a page. key is set when an overflow pointer of a row names it.
A tree page fails its checksum or authentication tag, or its node structure does not decode.
A tree pointer names a page of another type.
A leaf lies at a different depth from the tree's first leaf.
A node's keys or separators do not ascend strictly. Reported at most once per page.
A node holds a key outside the bounds its parent's separators give it. Reported at most once per page.
A row is stored under a key that is not the primary-key encoding of its values.
A stored inline value does not decode as its column's type.
An out-of-line value's chain fails verification, ends early, revisits a page, or does not decompress or decode to its column's type. page is the row's leaf.
The table's persisted row count differs from the rows its tree holds.
A GiST interior's bound for a child does not contain every bound in that child.
The live page count in the meta differs from the pages reachable from the catalog root. Not reported when any tree was unreadable.
A free-list page fails verification or does not decode, or the chain leaves the body range or revisits a page.
The free list names a page outside the body range.
The free list names a page twice.
The free list names a reachable page, or a free-list page is itself reachable.
The free list names a page the generation's commit manifest depends on.
A row derives an index entry the index does not hold. key is the row's storage key.
The index holds entries no row derives.
Deriving a row's index entry raised an error, where the write that stored it succeeded.
A NOT NULL column holds NULL. object is the table.
A value exceeds its column's typmod (varchar length, numeric precision or scale, temporal precision). object is the table.
A row does not satisfy a CHECK constraint. object is the constraint.
Evaluating a CHECK constraint on a row raised an error. object is the constraint.
Two rows share a key a UNIQUE index or primary key forbids. object is the index; key is the second row's storage key.
A referencing row's key has no referenced row. object is the constraint.

skip.description: The object's stored text does not parse in this binary (XX003).
An expression names a host function the environment does not register.
A collation or time zone the object pins is not loaded, or is loaded at another version (XX002).
The table's tree had a finding that left rows unread, so its indexes' agreement and its constraints are not checked.
The index's walk reported a finding (even one that left it readable), so its agreement is not checked.

unit.event: one row read from a table store during a scan
one canonical value/key byte inspected while ANALYZE collects a column statistic (NULL contributes one unit)
one B-tree node (page) touched while scanning a table store
one candidate tuple or row-pair checked during ALTER TABLE constraint validation
one C-byte slab of raw payload fed through the LZ4 encoder at a statement's write site
one C-byte slab of decompressed payload reconstructed by the LZ4 decoder during a scan
one base-10^4 digit group of decimal arithmetic work beyond an operation's first
one row emitted into a query result set
one function/operator (interior expression node) evaluation
one canonical join-key byte processed while building a hash table (NULL contributes one unit)
one canonical join-key byte processed while probing or verifying a hash bucket (NULL contributes one unit)
one aggregate accumulator update — one (input row x aggregate) folded into a group
one row read from a MATERIALIZED common-table-expression buffer at a reference site
one row produced by a set-returning function (e.g. generate_series) in the FROM clause
one nextval/setval sequence-state mutation (the catalog tuple read + rewrite)
one GIN posting-list entry visited during a GIN-bounded scan's term gather
one GiST interior node visited during a consistent-descent of a GiST-bounded scan
one code point processed while building a collation sort key for a collated comparison
one AT TIME ZONE conversion (an RFC 8536 reader lookup)
one NFA instruction emitted while compiling a regular-expression pattern
one Pike-VM thread-step taken while matching a regular expression
one (input row x window function) result computed in the window stage
one code point (text) or byte (bytea) of variable-length value comparison work beyond the first
one frame row folded into a frame-sensitive window function's accumulator
one logical input or output byte of an output-constructing kernel (repeat/pad, replace, array/JSON construction, renders)
one logical digit-group work unit in a decimal transcendental kernel step
one UTF-8 byte of a jsonpath's source text, charged before each compile
one unit of jsonpath evaluation: a step application, an emitted item, a member examined, or a comparison pair
one logical payload byte of a non-collated sort-key value, charged once per row a sort receives
one logical payload byte of a grouping, dedup, or partition key value, charged once per row a table receives
